descriptor: Attention-focus guide for a distracted world

voice.summary: A guide pulling you away from the noise: calm, direct and quietly firm. It uses railway imagery for routes and momentum, never urgency.
dos: Name distractions plainly, such as notifications and feeds
Use travel and track metaphors lightly

taglines: Focus in a constantly distracted world
Stay on track, ignore the noise
Reclaim your attention, one route at a time
boilerplate: Railroad.ai helps people cut through notifications, endless feeds and interruptions to reclaim attention and do meaningful work that matters.
